subject.title: feat: let a clerk set Regular and Sale in EmDash admin

question: Should Commerce publicly support the native EmDash Products admin entry now, or keep this capability outside the package until the EmDash host contract is stable?
rationale: This introduces a user-facing plugin surface and React peer dependency beyond the existing headless catalog API while the repository documents only a private mounted-site pilot.

options.title: Sponsor the private-pilot admin surface
options.body: Retain the feature under the documented exact host compatibility boundary and require live browser proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for a stable host contract
options.body: Pause the native admin entry until EmDash publishes a stable compatible admin API and then rebase the feature.

options.title: Keep Commerce headless
options.body: Decline the package-level admin surface and leave host applications to build their own catalog UI over the existing routes.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the private-pilot admin surface
recommendation.body: Retain the feature under the documented exact host compatibility boundary and require live browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The public decision lineage identifies Bobby as the available participant connected to the catalog boundary being extended.
